decision: Automated feature coverage passed; authenticated hosted acceptance and full production-readiness certification remain open.

browser.mode: synthetic service adapters; actual React page/components

employee.name: Home exposes employee tasks and excludes privileged destinations
Home search submits a native GET query to help
Ticket creation requires subject and description with optional sections closed
Request failure focuses feedback and preserves draft and idempotency key; retry navigates
Cancel retains a draft when discard is declined
Optional category/location and guides expand using keyboard
Assigned equipment retains tag and serial without inventory administration
Appearance switches immediately and persists after reload
Mobile navigation contains focus, closes on Escape, and restores focus
Complete request page reflows at mobile and compact desktop widths
Employee request list exposes status, search recovery, and no staff mutations
Notification read failure stays visible and preserves the selected notification
Profile retains edits after save failure and discloses workplace details
Chat intake validates fields and retains the first message after failure
Employee chat exposes public messaging without internal-note controls
Command search handles failure, retry, keyboard selection and Escape
Inventory request validates destination, preserves failed draft, and retries

admin.name: Admin navigation exposes work and management destinations
Queue bulk selection shows actions only for selected tickets
Desktop ticket drawer opens from queue and Escape restores the queue
IT message composer separates private and public drafts and retains failed sends
Staff ticket intake retains requester, priority and automatic routing
Administration groups settings links without horizontal overflow
People management protects own account and preserves permission drafts
Equipment handover requires explicit unit confirmation
Asset editor preserves identity and optional warranty dates after failed save
Article editor retains selected related guides and content on save failure
Report builder prevents empty measures and submits chosen report definition

fixes: Updated stale employee chat and equipment assertions to current product copy.
Repaired mobile-navigation effect capture and missing router mocks in UI tests.
Added repeatable local employee-first/admin-second browser acceptance coverage.
limits: Browser scenarios use actual React pages/components with synthetic service adapters and mocked Next.js routing, not authenticated hosted end-to-end transactions.

No authenticated employee or admin live session was available; sign-in/MFA, invitation acceptance, real persistence, uploads, email delivery, realtime synchronization, and protected database readiness were not verified live in this pass.
Docker is unavailable locally; the dedicated full Supabase-stack regression job was not rerun here. Existing embedded-database tests are included in the 932-test run.
Physical-backup restore certification remains open per the existing pilot release record.
